name: [CRED] CS PDCA edit → client_sequencers · Bison + Aimfox keys

nodes.name: [AF] Resolve workspace
nodes.notes: GET /accounts returns accounts[].workspace_id for the token that asked. No key -> 401 -> continues with an error item, and the SQL simply gets an empty workspace.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Collect credentials').item.json.payload, (() => { const a = Array.isArray($json.accounts) ? $json.accounts : []; const ids = [...new Set(a.map(x => x && x.workspace_id).filter(Boolean))]; return ids.length === 1 ? ids[0] : ''; })() ] }}

parameters.query:
-- CS PDCA credential edit -> client_sequencers.
-- $1 is a JSON array of {ws, bison_key, aimfox_key} built by the Code node above.
with p as (select $1::text::jsonb as j, nullif(btrim($2), '') as aimfox_ws),
src as (
  select nullif(btrim(r->>'ws'),'')         as ws,
         nullif(btrim(r->>'bison_key'),'')  as bison_key,
         nullif(btrim(r->>'aimfox_key'),'') as aimfox_key
    from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
),
bison  as (select id from public.sequencers where key = 'emailbison'),
aimfox as (select id from public.sequencers where key = 'aimfox'),
-- The payload's only client identity is the Bison workspace id (CS PDCA col_5), so every write
-- below hangs off the emailbison row that already carries it. No such row -> reported, never
-- guessed: creating one needs the client name, which this payload does not carry. The 6-hourly
-- sheets-bison-credential-sync owns that case.
target as (
  select cs.client_id, src.ws, src.bison_key, src.aimfox_key
    from src
    join bison on true
    join public.client_sequencers cs
      on cs.external_workspace_id = src.ws
     and cs.sequencer_id = bison.id
   where src.ws is not null
),
-- 1. Bison: refresh in place, matched on the workspace id (never on a name), only when it differs.
upd_bison as (
  update public.client_sequencers cs
     set api_key = t.bison_key, enabled = true, updated_at = now()
    from target t, bison
   where cs.external_workspace_id = t.ws
     and cs.sequencer_id = bison.id
     and t.bison_key is not null
     and cs.api_key is distinct from t.bison_key
  returning cs.id
),
-- 2. Aimfox: upsert on (client_id, sequencer_id), key AND workspace id.
--    The workspace id used to be left NULL because CS PDCA does not carry it (DA is the token and
--    there is no other column), and a row without it authenticates API calls but CANNOT resolve an
--    inbound webhook -- Get Workspace Api Key matches on external_workspace_id, so a NULL row makes
--    every event for that client vanish silently, in Supabase AND in the client sheet, with the
--    execution still green. "[AF] Resolve workspace" now reads it from the token's own GET
--    /accounts. Still nullable: an unresolvable token must not block the key from being stored.
aimfox_src as (
  select distinct on (t.client_id) t.client_id, t.aimfox_key, (select aimfox_ws from p) as aimfox_ws
    from target t
   where t.aimfox_key is not null
   order by t.client_id
),
ups_aimfox as (
  insert into public.client_sequencers (client_id, sequencer_id, api_key, external_workspace_id, enabled)
  select a.client_id, (select id from aimfox), a.aimfox_key, a.aimfox_ws, true from aimfox_src a
  on conflict (client_id, sequencer_id) do update
     set api_key = excluded.api_key,
         -- never blank a known workspace with an unresolved one
         external_workspace_id = coalesce(excluded.external_workspace_id,
                                          public.client_sequencers.external_workspace_id),
         enabled = true, updated_at = now()
   -- the old guard was api_key only, so a row whose key was already current could never acquire its
   -- missing workspace id -- exactly how FitMech kept a valid key and a NULL workspace
   where public.client_sequencers.api_key is distinct from excluded.api_key
      or (excluded.external_workspace_id is not null
          and public.client_sequencers.external_workspace_id is distinct from excluded.external_workspace_id)
  returning (xmax = 0) as inserted, external_workspace_id
)
select (select count(*) from src)                            as rows_in,
       (select count(*) from target)                         as clients_resolved,
       (select count(*) from upd_bison)                      as bison_keys_refreshed,
       (select count(*) from ups_aimfox where inserted)      as aimfox_rows_created,
       (select count(*) from ups_aimfox where not inserted)  as aimfox_keys_refreshed,
       (select aimfox_ws from p)                             as aimfox_workspace_resolved,
       (select count(*) from ups_aimfox
         where external_workspace_id is not null)            as aimfox_rows_with_workspace,
       (select string_agg(s.ws, ', ' order by s.ws)
          from src s
         where s.ws is not null
           and not exists (select 1 from target t where t.ws = s.ws)) as unmatched_workspaces;
